text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару gives it her all on
the
chrysanthemum stage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the strenuous undertaking, she
states
joyfully that the gods have made
her the
incarnation of happiness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Concerned by the crazed glint in her
eye, I leave
most of her schedule open
until the Kinko Sho
next spring.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
